_notes: Entering orbit around every world, recorded by running each star's own generateOrbital (planets/generate/), then its generateMinerals, generateEnergy and generateLife for every node, as GeneratePlanetSurface in scan.c does. See tools/extract/golden/systems.c.

Every world is entered from a new game's state (all game state zero). No alien ships are present (StartSphereTracking is false), so homeworld conversations don't start and the world is orbited as when its owners are gone. Nothing has been picked up.

systems: per star in starmap order, per planet a list: the planet, then its moons in order. Each world: [data_index, entered] and, if orbit was entered: [scan seeds: mineral, energy, biological], [report: AxialTilt, Tectonics, Weather, PlanetDensity, PlanetRadius, SurfaceGravity, SurfaceTemperature, RotationPeriod, AtmoDensity, LifeChance, PlanetToSunDist] as generateOrbital leaves PLANET_INFO, and nodes: [minerals, energy, life], each a list of [x, y, type, density] (NODE_INFO), or null for a shielded world, which can't be scanned; then the orbit screen's scan text, as UQM's own PrintCoarseScanPC (scan.c) prints it: orbit, atmosphere, temperature, weather, tectonics, mass, radius, gravity, day, tilt. Labels and unit words come from the content's strings, which are empty here, so a value that is only a word (Vacuum, Super Thick, None) is empty, and unit words are missing ("0.39" is 0.39 a.u., " 3" is Class 3).

Mineral type is the element (data/elements.json id); density is MAKE_WORD (gross size 0..2, quantity). Life type is the creature (data/lifeforms.json; 23 is an Evil One, 24 a Brainbox Bulldozer, 25 Zex's Beauty).
map_width and map_height: the surface map node positions are on (MAP_WIDTH, MAP_HEIGHT at 320x240).
